name: freshctx
description: A live, versioned context layer for coding agents.

scripts.test:docs: node --test test/living-docs.test.mjs test/ise-vocabulary.test.mjs test/layout-contract.test.mjs test/gotchas-contract.test.mjs test/manifests.test.mjs
scripts.check:py: python3 -m py_compile bench/hermes-native-bridge.py bench/python-ast-oracle.py adapters/hermes/__init__.py labs/stale-view-prevalence-v1/measure.py labs/stale-view-prevalence-v1/test_measure.py labs/freshctx-replay-v1/extract.py labs/freshctx-replay-v1/fetch_repos.py labs/freshctx-replay-v1/test_extract.py
scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs bench/*.mjs autoresearch/*.mjs examples/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs capture/*.mjs adapters/*.mjs adapters/pi/*.mjs adapters/hermes/*.mjs ise/treesitter/*.mjs test/*.mjs test/helpers/*.mjs $(find docs/lab labs -name '*.mjs'); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && npm run -s check:py
scripts.ci: npm run -s check && npm test && npm run -s test:docs && npm run -s bench && npm run -s ctxbench && npm run -s evaluate > /tmp/evaluate.txt && cat /tmp/evaluate.txt && npm run -s evaluate:check-docs -- --input=/tmp/evaluate.txt && npm run -s papers:list && npm run -s test:py && npm run -s holdout:verify -- --pack=holdout-v0.1 && npm run -s holdout:ci-guard -- --base=origin/main
